name: bl-annual-business-contribution
description: Saint-Barthélemy annual business contribution reference researched in 2026 from the local Contributions Code, its 2024 amendment and official administrative material. Covers the fixed and employee-based components, dormant companies, separate activities, annual payment, new-business treatment and dissolution evidence. Highlights the amended staff-count documentation and the mismatch with wording on an older form. Includes conditional calculations without assuming an unsupported headcount method. Complete amendment reconciliation, special exemptions, penalties, current forms and independent accountant review remain outstanding. This is a source-cited draft for the local CFAE, not a general assertion of tax-free business profits.
